title: The Wandering Jew's Chronicle
author: Martin Parker (ballad); edited by Giles Bergel
institution: Bodleian Libraries, University of Oxford (editor Giles Bergel; design InfoDev, Oxford IT Services)
license_note: Text is CC BY-NC 3.0; the images remain the copyright of their holders.
notes: Quasi-diplomatic transcriptions with images of 15 copies of an English broadside ballad printed between 1634 and 1830, compared in a Versioning Machine interface, with bibliography and a textual history. The four copies printed before 1700 are A.2.a (Francis Grove, Charles I version), and C.1.a, C.2.a, C.3.a (Charles II versions, Coles/Vere/Wright and others). The other 11 copies are from the 18th and 19th centuries. Status archived: the site and the GitHub repository were last changed in December 2016. The counts cover those four copies, and the dates of the copies are approximate placeholders from the resource description. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
